title: Friday
about: Two friends sit on a front porch in South Central LA through one very long Friday.
cue: Serve the snacks when Craig and Smokey settle in on the porch.
faces: Never two things that match. Now they do.
Drumsticks, corn, potato salad. Deebo, keep walking.
Dipped, crunchy. Big Worm wants his money first.
With sugar this time. Big cups, lots of ice.

phone:
Normandie & Western MarketFridayIt's Friday. Nowhere to be,nothing to do.So you getting fed.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCraig's peanut butter jelly toastiesNever two things that match. Now they do.How to make it8 slices of thick white bread160g smooth peanut butter160g strawberry jam40g soft butter1 tbsp icing sugarSpread peanut butter on four slices of the bread and jam on the other four, then press together.Butter the outsides of the sandwiches.Cook in a frying pan over medium heat, pressing down, until golden and the filling is warm, turning once.Dust with icing sugar, cut into triangles and serve warm.Porch ham and beef slidersHam, no burger. Fixed.How to make it500g beef mince200g leg ham6 slices of cheddar12 slider buns12 dill pickle slicesShape the mince into 12 small patties and season well.Cook on a hot pan for about 2 minutes a side.Brown folded ham slices in the pan, top each patty with ham and half a slice of cheddar, and cover for a minute to melt.Put in the slider buns with pickles.Pineapple spearsGrill-charred. Bye, Felisha.How to make it1 large pineapple1 lime1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp salt1 tbsp caster sugar12 skewersPeel and core the pineapple and cut into 12 long spears.Heat a grill pan until smoking and char the spears for 2 minutes a side until marked.Mix the chilli powder, salt, caster sugar and the zest of the lime.Squeeze the lime over the warm pineapple, sprinkle with the chilli mix and push a skewer into each spear.Chill for 20 minutes before serving.MainsPorch day BBQ plateDrumsticks, corn, potato salad. Deebo, keep walking.How to make it12 chicken drumsticks1 tsp salt1/2 tsp black pepper2 tsp smoked paprika250ml barbecue sauce4 corn cobs40g butter500g potato saladToss the drumsticks with salt, pepper and smoked paprika.Roast at 200°C until starting to colour.Brush with barbecue sauce and grill or roast, basting twice, until sticky.Boil the corn for 6 minutes and roll in the butter.Serve the chicken with the corn and potato salad.SweetsBig Worm's conesDipped, crunchy. Big Worm wants his money first.How to make it1 L vanilla ice cream8 ice cream cones200g dark chocolate3 tbsp coconut oil40g cornflakes, crushed2 tbsp sprinklesMelt the chocolate with the coconut oil and let it cool to room temperature.Scoop the ice cream into the cones.Freeze the filled cones for 20 minutes (included in cook time).Dip each top in the chocolate and roll straight away in the crushed cornflakes mixed with sprinkles.Freeze until serving.DrinksRed drinkWith sugar this time. Big cups, lots of ice.How to make it250g strawberries150g caster sugar2 lemons, juiced500ml cherry juice1 L cold water1 bag iceBlend the strawberries with the sugar and lemon juice, then strain into a big jug.Add the cherry juice and cold water and stir until the sugar is gone.Pour over plenty of ice in big plastic cups.
